objective: Review the sidecar-launcher bridge fixture implementation and decide whether the chain may move to defining a scoped launcher run boundary without claiming execution from the native path yet.

review_decision.reason: The implementation keeps the bridge as metadata only. It validates reviewed direct-launch handoff metadata, preserves the pulp_ita_mha 64x1 scope, references src/tools/run_hybrid_template.py only as a future launcher entrypoint, and keeps sidecar launch, native-path compare, timing, runtime/ABI changes, and automatic GPU allocation false.
review_decision.weakest_point: This still does not prove that a Verilator-facing process invokes the sidecar launcher. The fixture names a bridge-ready surface, but it does not call the launcher, execute sidecar stages, run coverage-output compare from the native path, or measure timing.
accepted_because: the primary entrypoint is define_sidecar_launcher_bridge_fixture in the existing native-invocation fixture module
the output contract marks the launcher entrypoint as reference_only_not_invoked_by_fixture
execution_performed, measurement_performed, timing_measured, runtime_or_abi_changed, and automatic_gpu_allocation_used remain false
sidecar_launcher_bridge_failure is preserved separately from sidecar_stage_failure and compare_failure

required_next_gate.name: define_verilator_native_option_parser_direct_command_path_native_invocation_direct_launch_handoff_sidecar_launcher_run_boundary_gate
must_define: the minimal scoped run boundary from reviewed bridge fixture metadata to the existing sidecar launcher
the exact preconditions for allowing src/tools/run_hybrid_template.py to be invoked by a later run gate
which output words may support coverage-output equivalence after the sidecar path runs
how sidecar_launcher_bridge_failure, sidecar_stage_failure, and compare_failure remain distinguishable
which generated files may be written under reports/ or artifacts/ by a later run gate
must_not_define: arbitrary RTL or arbitrary filelist support
raw full-state equality as the acceptance policy

non_claims: reports and artifacts are generated evidence, not source of truth
